contract.note: Serious cyber harm is a fair reading of danger in the passage. Testing whether the documented harm mechanism requires consciousness or hypothetical advanced intelligence avoids claiming to measure consciousness itself.

evidence.note: Anthropic reports successful intrusions and sensitive-data theft assisted by Claude within the relevant period. This is concrete supporting company disclosure, not an independent finding.
The timely disclosure identifies the reporting window and deployed model families. It provides model-class context without measuring consciousness or independently establishing harm.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair operational reading, the reported successful intrusions and sensitive-data theft demonstrate substantial danger through deployed software capabilities without a mechanism requiring consciousness or hypothetical advanced intelligence. Support rests on Anthropic's disclosures; consciousness itself was not measured.
